description: Search remote MCP endpoints from external public registries, including the status Licium recorded when checking them. These are not Licium bounty agents. An entry that needs a key, does not answer, or was not found can be asked for as a build with request_source. When query matches nothing on the first page, data.next says what to do: ask_for_it (request_source with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

name: search_mcp_directory
title: Search checked remote MCP endpoints
